qualification: Final immutable candidate passed 32 Direct + 14 Graph cases and two public-header checks on each of W1, Air and Mini. W1/Air validation layers reported no Validation Error, VUID or SYNC-HAZARD; Mini signs correctness/portability only.
One test-only compilation correction and one audited product numerical correction followed the initial candidate. Original FAIL logs remain included. No tolerance was relaxed.

LogSoftmax excludes one maximum from the exponential sum. Below tail 1/64 a fifth-degree log1p polynomial avoids native log near one; precise preserves the subtraction/compensation order. Tiny tails, tied maxima, both cutoff sides and large common offsets passed independent FP64/rounded references.

Reduce Sum/Mean/Min/Max supports F32/F16/BF16, arbitrary admitted axes/keepdim/strides/Views, scalar/rank-eight/empty domains, NaN propagation and signed-zero min/max. Half outputs have one writer per packed word.

Softmax/LogSoftmax supports three floating storage types, finite scale, arbitrary axis and broadcast Bool/same-type additive masks. Widths 0/1/127/129/2048/2049/8193/32769, inner 1/2/3, odd native View origins and nonfinite rows passed.

F32, contiguous-axis half and even-inner half use one dispatch. Odd inner greater than one uses bounded eight-byte-per-row statistics and a second word-owned dispatch. Shared row caching is cold-qualified by width and device shared-memory capacity.

Independent L2 and masked-probability Graph combinations, two invocation slots, changing bindings, retained old outputs, close, guard bytes, alias rejection and native buffer/recording counters passed. Steady submit does not allocate/record/search providers.

These reduction shaders are HYLE implementations using reviewed algorithm structures, not a newly integrated ggml runtime or proof of best-of. The provider-first source audit governs the next C1 work.
setup_issues: An initial Air SSH launcher referenced absent /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; corrected to existing /usr/bin/python3 before any validation attempt.

Air selector initially lacked cmake on SSH PATH; failure log is retained. Adding the existing /opt/homebrew/bin to that command PATH produced READY; no product build/test was repeated for this environment issue.
